title: Chimes Loop (Xtra Loop)
description: This short loopable recording is formed from ringing my chimes six times. There are no subliminal words or hidden traps, just pure ringing sounds for you to enjoy. I first shared this over on my discord server while I was still working on what would become "Chimes and Pleasure". Originally I started making it entirely SFW ... However, that didn't last long. This sample track should hopefully incorporate my chimes well on top of many other files, and so I encourage you to mix and layer as works for you.
author: Mistress Shibby
